teaser: When did you last leave a conversation still holding three more things you wanted to say? Life path 3 is yours, and so is ENFP — a crossing where the gift for words and the gift for possibility sit on top of each other instead of taking turns. Most who carry either trait learn to ration it: speak less, dream less, pick a lane. You rarely get that memo. The two reinforce each other so completely that the risk isn't dullness. It's two voices talking over the one thing either of them actually meant to say.
